# YektaD — From Hidden to Found

> Custom websites, sharper positioning, and simple growth systems for independent founders and small teams (1–10 people). Done properly, by someone who actually cares.

## About YektaD

YektaD is a small studio founded by **Yekta Dastranj**, based in London, UK. We work with independent founders and small teams — usually one to ten people — who are great at what they do but largely invisible online.

Every engagement is led personally by Yekta. A small number of clients at a time, so each one gets real attention.

## Who We Help

We work with small businesses that:

- Have genuine skill and happy customers
- Are mostly invisible online — or look much smaller than they really are
- Want to grow without losing what makes the business theirs
- Care about doing things properly, not just quickly

Typical clients include solo founders, independent consultants, small studios, local service businesses, and small B2B providers.

## What We Do

### 1. Custom Websites
A custom site built from scratch — designed around your work, fast to load, easy to update, and built to be found on Google. No templates, no clutter.

### 2. Positioning & Brand
Sharper language and clearer positioning — what you say, who it's for, and why someone should choose you. Confident, true to you.

### 3. Growth Systems
Practical systems that help your business run more smoothly and bring in the right kind of work — without you having to manage everything yourself.

## How We Work

1. **Discovery Session** — A free 30-minute conversation to understand your business and see if we're a good fit.
2. **Tailored Plan** — Within 48 hours, you get a clear, honest proposal scoped to what you actually need.
3. **The Work** — We do most of the heavy lifting. You get clear updates, only the meetings that matter.
4. **Going Live & Beyond** — A simple handover so you can run things yourself, with support when you want it.

## What Makes YektaD Different

- **Selective by design** — A handful of clients at a time, so each one gets real attention.
- **Whole-business view** — Website, positioning, and systems looked at together, not in isolation.
- **One person, fully invested** — Every email, every decision comes from Yekta.
- **Built around you** — No templates, no copy-paste strategies, no jargon.

## Client Stories

### Studio Solena (Beauty & Wellness, London)
+65% increase in appointments within 3 months. "Yekta built a proper system around how we actually work."

### Pizza Fly (Food Service)
3x increase in online orders within 6 weeks of launch.

### Mainteniq (Maintenance, London)
Brand identity and website built together — finally taken seriously as the credible team they always were.

## VandaVee — Proof of Range

Yekta also led operations and growth for VandaVee, a small founder-led luxury furniture brand, putting the systems, partnerships and supply chain in place to ship internationally (Italy → US → France). Includes a proprietary NFC + Letter of Authentication system designed and built from scratch. Proof that careful work scales — even when the business stays small.

## FAQ

### How is YektaD different from a marketing agency or freelancer?
No ads, no social-post factory. A small number of small businesses at a time, looking at the whole picture — website, positioning, and the small systems that help you grow.

### How much does it cost?
Every business is different, so every proposal is scoped to what you actually need. After the Discovery Session you'll get a clear, honest proposal — no packages off a menu.

### What results can I expect, and how quickly?
Most small businesses start seeing better enquiries within a couple of months of going live. The bigger win is steadier work and a business that runs more calmly.

### Is this right for solo founders or very small teams?
Yes — that's exactly the focus. Most clients are 1–10 people.

### Why not just use a website builder or template?
You can — and for some businesses, it's enough. But templated sites usually look templated, rank poorly, and quietly cost you enquiries you don't even know you're missing.
